integrity: The proof gives an explicit larger witness with no greater Schemmel value in every parameter range. All algebraic reductions, exceptional prime gaps and small cases are explicit; bounded computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles prime squares only. It does not classify higher prime powers or complete sparse Schemmel sets. The proof uses the published consecutive-prime ratio lemma; the accompanying computation independently replays its finite range but does not reprove the asymptotic prime-gap estimate.
title: Prime squares are never sparsely Schemmel totient
